pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual dark regions exhibit polygonal and sub-ovoid geometries with moderately smooth pixel-level gradients at the edges. Patches on the mid-flank are larger and more angular, while those on the neck are more elongated. Relative spatial area of the patches is approximately 85% compared to the lighter pathways.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Negative-space pathways consist of light cream-colored corridors forming a continuous topological graph. Junction nodes are predominantly trivalent intersections. Pixel thickness is generally consistent across the torso but shows slight narrowing in the cervical region.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane silhouette along the upper neck displays a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated edge where dark brown pixels terminate against the background luminance.

focal_dorsal_anomalies.chronic_feeding_lesions: Localized regions of textural disruption and hyper-pigmented dark brown clusters are visible within the patches on the upper flank and along the mid-dorsal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several prominent, dark, raised, and textured nodules are visible on the lower neck and ventral-thoracic junction, appearing as irregular masses with low-luminance pixel values and a bumpy surface topology.
